title: feat(ui): a record page's related tab is the child object's full list
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTKEPqtmiK9SGpHsmW

Fixes #35892

## What changes

On a record page, a related list opened as its own tab (and the same list in the record drawer) now works like the child object's list page:

- **Head row.** The child list's tile and title on the left, **+ Add** on the right. The **Open in list** (↗) button is gone.
- **Condition row.** The list page's own Sort (several levels) and Filter: `@object-ui/plugin-list` exports it as `ListConditionsBlock`, and because `plugin-detail` sits below `plugin-list`, the record page hands it to the tab through a new slot, `RelatedListConditionsSlotContext` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`), the way `RecordBodyTableEditorSlotContext` hands in the edit-state editor. It is a host element, not a registered node type, so the registered-types ratchet (every registered type is authorable) is untouched. No view switch, view settings or search. Its labels fold to icons by the row's own width (narrow tab, drawer, phone); no horizontal page scroll.
- **Grid.** The list page's grid host keys: column menu, select-first cells with the list page's cell editing wherever the reader may edit the child object (`listInlineEdit` affordance), row selection with the floating bulk bar, and the footer row. Bulk delete is offered where the host hands a row delete and the child object's `relatedRowDelete` row of the affordance map allows it (the write census names the new site). It asks once, counting the rows, then sends the selection (up to every matching row) to the data source's `bulkDelete` in one call; only a data source without one falls back to the row delete the list was handed, all rows settled together, as the list page settles them. The tab then shows how many rows were deleted and how many failed, in the list page's own words (`objectActions.bulkDeleteSuccess` / `bulkDeletePartial`). Footer calculations run over every matching row (`findParams`), not the loaded ones. A status-grouped tab draws no footer row.
- **Loading.** Rows load as the reader scrolls (a growing window of 50, sentinel 320px ahead) instead of a pager.
- **Counts.** The tab title keeps counting every child; a filter never changes it. The footer counts the rows the filter keeps. A filter that matches nothing says so and keeps the condition row.
- **What lasts.** Sort, filter and footer picks last while the reader stays on the record: across its tabs and between its page and drawer. They are keyed by the reader as well as the record (as the list page's draft is keyed by its reader), so another account signed in on the same tab starts from the default. A reload or another record clears them; a drawer opened over another record counts as another record, so the tab behind it starts from the default again, which is the ruling's "another record". **Discard** appears once something changed and puts the tab back; there is no Save. The list page's Discard and this one are one component, `ConditionDiscardButton` (`app-shell`'s `ListDraftActions` now draws it; same look and behaviour as #36026).
- A header sort pick joins an existing multi-level sort by the list page's rule, now shared as `withHeaderSortPick` (`@object-ui/core`).
- The record page (`app-shell` `RecordDetailView`, which the drawer draws too) fills the slot with the block, lazy-loaded with the first tab that draws it.

Supersedes the remembered related-tab sort of #35601 (取代 #35601 的记住排序), on ruling https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35892#issuecomment-7064083597 (session-only). Column widths and order for the related tab move to the reader's browser, as the list page keeps them, on ruling https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/35892#issuecomment-7064246280: `RelatedList` no longer reads or writes them in `sys_user_preference`; the `RelatedListPreference` type stays (no narrowing). Keeping widths after sign-out is #36110, not this PR.

**Upgrade note** (also in the changeset): the header sort and the column widths and order an earlier version remembered for a related tab no longer apply (子表页签里以前记住的排序不再生效). The tab opens in its declared order and its widths start from the default once. Nothing stored is deleted. The default sort and columns of every related list are unchanged.

## Why

#35892 (epic #35590): the related tab was a reduced list with a pager and an exit to the list page; the reader had to leave the record to sort, filter or total the children.

## Verification

Evidence: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35892/` (index `README.md`, shots in `shots/`), from `examples/app-crm` with this branch's console build, Acme Corp → Opportunities (70 children). Light and dark at 1440, 720, 375, plus the record pane opened from the list (app-crm has no drawer navigation).

Measured in the real console:
- Sort + filter chips, Discard after a change and gone after Discard; kept after another tab and back; cleared by reload.
- Tab title 70 while the footer says 14 records under a filter.
- Scroll loads 50 → 70.
- Footer Sum 3,349,000.00 equals the API total over all 70 rows.
- 375: labels fold to icons, no horizontal page scroll.

**#36023 leftover 2 (三项实测, in the tab at 1440):**
1. Enter while editing Deal Value (9000 → 9100): `PATCH crm_opportunity {"amount":9100}`, toast "1 row saved", the selection stays on the same cell.
2. Tab while editing (9100 → 9000): `PATCH {"amount":9000}`, the selection moves one cell right.
3. Enter on Expected Close: the calendar opens directly under the cell (cell bottom 345px, popover top 347px, same left edge) with Today / Tomorrow / Next week / Clear; picking the 15th sends `PATCH {"close_date":"2026-12-15"}`, the cell reads "Dec 15" and the calendar closes.

The edited record was restored afterwards.

Tests:
- New: `RelatedList.tab-35892.test.tsx` (13, including a host that supplies no condition row, the batch delete in one call, a partial failure on both paths, and a second reader starting from the default), `relatedTabConditions-35892.test.ts` (5), `ListConditionsBlock-35892.test.tsx` (5).
- Rewritten: `RelatedList.enlargedListGrid-28865.test.tsx` (growing window, scroll load, footer, column widths no longer stored server-side), `RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx` (no ↗, header sort not written, remembered sort not read).
- `vitest run packages/plugin-detail`: 398 files / 3664 tests passed. plugin-list, i18n, app-shell views, core: see the checks.
- Builds of `@object-ui/plugin-list`, `plugin-detail`, `app-shell`, console: pass. ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors. Eager ui-components budget unchanged in kind (339.5 / 346.7 KB).

Overlap (`scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` at 5b76d7a5): merges cleanly with `origin/main` (main merged in at 5bad102b, which also took #36096: the `@object-ui/core` import line of `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` keeps both `isObjectExportOffered` and `withHeaderSortPick`) and with #36131, #36128, #36123, #36114. With #36136 one line conflicts: the `@object-ui/plugin-detail` import line of `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, where this PR adds `RelatedListConditionsSlotContext` (plus the `./relatedListConditions.js` import) and #36136 adds `stepDisplayText` to the `./RecordApprovalsPanel.js` import. Whichever lands second keeps both.

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

Clause-② is a widening: new exports `ListConditionsBlock` and `ListConditionsHostProps` (`@object-ui/plugin-list`), the slot `RelatedListConditionsSlotContext` and `RelatedListConditionsProps` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`), new exports `ConditionDiscardButton` and its type `ConditionDiscardButtonProps` (`@object-ui/plugin-list`) and `withHeaderSortPick` (`@object-ui/core`), new i18n keys in every locale pack (`listConditions.chips.discard`, `listConditions.chips.discardHint`, `detail.relatedNoMatches`, `detail.deleteRowsTitle`, and the count family `detail.deleteRowsConfirmation` with the plural slots each pack needs); nothing removed or renamed.
